status.label: Status
status.intro: BOCCHI needs the travel plugins below. For combat it only needs the plugin you chose under General → Combat rotation. Shopping needs Knightshopper.
status.shopping_intro: When you have enough silver or gold, BOCCHI returns to camp and lets Knightshopper buy your list. Set the list up in Knightshopper.
status.optional_intro_bmr: Wrath Combo also needs BossMod or BossMod Reborn.
status.optional_intro_rsr: Wrath Combo and Rotation Solver Reborn also need BossMod.
status.optional_intro_rsr_bmr: Wrath Combo and Rotation Solver Reborn also need BossMod or BossMod Reborn.
